product_overview: Wolfie Delivery is a production-focused food delivery platform for New York City, supporting customers, restaurants, drivers, and admins across order placement, real-time tracking, payments, chat, and platform operations. The system is built with a Flask backend, Supabase PostgreSQL, Stripe, Redis, and Flask-SocketIO for realtime delivery workflows.
core_goals: Enable customers to register, browse restaurants, place orders, and track deliveries in real time.
Support restaurant, driver, and customer coordination throughout the full order lifecycle.
Provide secure payment handling, saved payment methods, and webhook-based payment status updates.
Offer operational controls for admins to manage users, orders, refunds, and platform oversight.
Deliver notifications, chat, ratings, and live tracking to improve delivery experience and transparency.

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Allows customers to register, verify phone numbers via OTP, sign in, refresh tokens, and log out securely.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/register with name, email, phone, and password -> Receive 201 with user object and token -> POST /api/v1/auth/verify-otp with phone and valid OTP -> Receive 200 verified

POST /api/v1/auth/login with valid email and password -> Receive 200 with access_token, refresh_token, and user -> POST /api/v1/auth/refresh with valid refresh token -> Receive 200 with new access_token -> POST /api/v1/auth/logout with access token -> Receive 200 logged out
POST /api/v1/auth/register with missing or invalid fields -> Receive 400 validation error
POST /api/v1/auth/login with incorrect password -> Receive 401 invalid credentials
POST /api/v1/auth/verify-otp with incorrect OTP -> Receive 400 invalid OTP

features.name: Restaurant Management
features.description: Lets users discover active restaurants, inspect restaurant details, and view menu items.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/restaurants without authentication -> Receive 200 with list of active restaurants -> GET /api/v1/restaurants/<id> for a valid restaurant -> Receive 200 with restaurant details and menu items -> GET /api/v1/restaurants/<id>/menu -> Receive 200 with list of menu items
GET /api/v1/restaurants/<id> for an unknown restaurant id -> Receive 404 not found
GET /api/v1/restaurants/<id>/menu for an invalid restaurant id -> Receive 404 or empty result depending on backend behavior

features.name: Order Management
features.description: Enables authenticated customers to place orders, review order history, inspect order details, and cancel eligible orders.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/orders with restaurant_id, items, delivery_address, and payment_method_id after authentication -> Receive 201 with order object -> GET /api/v1/orders with access token -> Receive 200 with list of current user orders -> GET /api/v1/orders/<id> for the created order -> Receive 200 with order object
POST /api/v1/orders with missing items or invalid delivery_address -> Receive 400 validation error
GET /api/v1/orders/<id> with a non-existent order id -> Receive 404 not found
PATCH /api/v1/orders/<id>/cancel for an order that can no longer be cancelled -> Receive 400 cannot cancel

features.name: Payment Processing
features.description: Handles Stripe payment intent creation, retrieval of saved payment methods, deletion of saved payment methods, and webhook ingestion for payment events.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/payments/create-intent with amount and currency after authentication -> Receive 200 with client_secret -> POST /api/v1/payments/webhook with Stripe event payload -> Receive 200 received
GET /api/v1/payments/methods with access token -> Receive 200 with list of payment methods -> DELETE /api/v1/payments/methods/<id> with a valid saved method id -> Receive 200 deleted
POST /api/v1/payments/create-intent with invalid amount or currency -> Receive 400 error
DELETE /api/v1/payments/methods/<id> for a non-existent method -> Receive error response or failure state as enforced by backend

features.name: Driver Management
features.description: Supports driver availability management and live location updates for dispatch and tracking.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/drivers/available with authentication -> Receive 200 with list of available drivers -> PATCH /api/v1/drivers/<id>/status to set driver availability -> Receive 200 updated -> PATCH /api/v1/drivers/<id>/location with lat and lng -> Receive 200 updated
PATCH /api/v1/drivers/<id>/location with missing or invalid coordinates -> Receive validation error or failure response
PATCH /api/v1/drivers/<id>/status with invalid driver id -> Receive error or not-found response depending on backend enforcement

features.name: Live Order Tracking
features.description: Provides authenticated users with real-time tracking information for an order, including driver coordinates and status updates.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/tracking/<order_id> with a valid authenticated user and existing order -> Receive 200 with tracking object and driver coordinates
GET /api/v1/tracking/<order_id> for an unknown order id -> Receive 404 not found
GET /api/v1/tracking/<order_id> without a valid token -> Receive authentication failure

features.name: Ratings & Reviews
features.description: Allows customers to submit ratings and comments for completed orders and view restaurant ratings publicly.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/ratings with order_id, rating, and comment after authentication -> Receive 201 rating created -> GET /api/v1/ratings/<restaurant_id> -> Receive 200 with list of ratings
POST /api/v1/ratings with an invalid order_id or incomplete payload -> Receive validation error or failure response
GET /api/v1/ratings/<restaurant_id> for a restaurant with no ratings -> Receive 200 with empty list or minimal rating set

features.name: Admin Panel
features.description: Provides administrative access to users, orders, refunds, and platform oversight functions.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/admin/users with admin authentication -> Receive 200 with list of users -> GET /api/v1/admin/orders with admin authentication -> Receive 200 with list of orders -> POST /api/v1/admin/refunds with order_id and amount -> Receive 200 refund issued
GET /api/v1/admin/users without admin privileges -> Receive authorization failure
POST /api/v1/admin/refunds with invalid order_id or excessive amount -> Receive error response or validation failure

features.name: Notifications
features.description: Lets authenticated users fetch their notifications and mark individual notifications as read.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/notifications with access token -> Receive 200 with list of notifications -> PATCH /api/v1/notifications/<id>/read -> Receive 200 updated
PATCH /api/v1/notifications/<id>/read for a non-existent notification -> Receive error or not-found response
GET /api/v1/notifications without authentication -> Receive authentication failure

features.name: Chat
features.description: Supports in-order chat between customer, driver, and restaurant using REST endpoints for message history and sending messages.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/chat/<order_id> with authentication for an active order -> Receive 200 with list of messages -> POST /api/v1/chat/<order_id> with message and sender_type -> Receive 201 message sent
GET /api/v1/chat/<order_id> for an invalid or unauthorized order -> Receive 404 not found or authorization failure
POST /api/v1/chat/<order_id> with empty message body -> Receive validation error
